# `compat/interposers/raf.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/interposers/raf.js`

interposers/raf.js — managed requestAnimationFrame for a guest realm. Guest render loops are the #1 resource leak when an app's window closes: the raw `requestAnimationFrame` loop keeps running forever. This shim tracks every pending frame and cancels them all on `realm.destroy()`, so closing a guest window actually stops its GPU work. Errors thrown inside a frame callback are reported instead of silently killing the loop's owner.
